title: Get Order Customs Requirements
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-10
html:
Path: /fulfillment/202607/orders/customs_info/query

Method: [POST]

Function Description

This API is used to query whether an order requires extra customs clearance information, whether such information has been submitted, and the list of submitted customs clearance information. If extra customs clearance information is required but not yet provided, the merchant must complete and submit it before shipment can proceed.

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters
